offline_repair.source_binding: A validated sole ordinal 1 may supply an ETA in the archived neutral single-clock form when no personal opening scope or write authority was chosen. Unknown ordinals and booleans do not become clock evidence.
offline_repair.query_control: With a 19:25 and a 20:00 red-center fixture in actual SQLite, a fixed 19:30 read is rejected, the same-day ETA range returns the 20:00 table, and the 19:25 table is only a nearby option requiring timing confirmation. Fixed creation is still rejected.
offline_repair.unresolved_times: A personal ETA awaiting a resolvable bound permits a broad lookup. It does not permit a fixed instant, alias, or zero-width interval. Named-table and independently verified fixed opening lookup controls remain valid.
